summary_rationale: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Ltd (RPEL) has transformed a historically fragmented, unorganized commodity mineral—silica ramming mass for induction furnaces—into an automated, R&D-backed consumable franchise generating 30.3% ROCE, 24.3% ROE, and 29%–30% operating margins on a near-debt-free balance sheet (₹5 Cr borrowings vs. ₹282 Cr net worth as of Sep 2026). Over FY15–FY26, revenue scaled 6.8x from ₹38 Cr to ₹257 Cr (₹315 Cr TTM) while net profit compounded from ₹1 Cr to ₹55 Cr (₹70 Cr TTM), driven by boric-acid-free premix innovation (RM 9901), exports to 39–40 countries, and disciplined margin expansion from 7% to 30%. The KPI watchpoint is working capital intensity: Inventory Days climbed from 159 days in FY23 to 272 days in FY26, pushing the Cash Conversion Cycle to 255 days and trimming FY26 CFO/EBITDA conversion to 70% ahead of the 350,000 MTPA Odisha joint venture with TRL Krosaki.
